user.title: Vega MT X CAN
user.description: The Vega tracker connects to this Home Assistant host directly. Point the tracker's Setting 3001 server slot to this host and the port below. Commands are OFF by default — no setting is written to the vehicle until you enable them in the integration options.

data_description.log_downlink: Fire a vega_downlink event for every frame sent to the tracker — both HA's own (commands/queries) and cloud frames relayed through the proxy. Events are stored by the recorder (see Developer Tools → Events / Logbook) and kept for the recorder's global purge_keep_days. Off by default.
